content.short: DegenScore issues a wallet-activity score and provides an Ethereum soulbound beacon, a non-transferable NFT, to document Web3 participation.
content.description: DegenScore provides a wallet activity-based score that reflects a user’s participation in Web3 by tracking interactions with DeFi contracts and protocols. When you connect your wallet to the DegenScore beacon, a score is generated instantly. The beacon is an Ethereum soulbound token—a non-transferable NFT—that records your involvement with Web3 projects and can be shared with the broader community to demonstrate your on-chain activity.
content.meta: DegenScore issues a wallet interaction-based score reflecting user participation in Web3 with DeFi contracts and protocols. Discover DegenScore and other Identity Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
